posts.summary: Argues Trump entering lame-duck phase, losing political power

posts.text:
There are unmistakable signs that his Lame Duck Era has begun. Trump’s poll numbers are crossing the Nixon Line. His own appointees are defying him and even Republicans seem to be tuning him out.
